The software platform **Digistore24** at **digistore24.com** is directly operated and provided by **Digistore24 GmbH** (the original German operating entity), operating internationally alongside regional entities including **Digistore24 Inc.** (US/Americas) and **Digistore24 MSLW Limited** (Ireland/EU).

### Evidence and Provider Statements
* **Digistore24 GmbH** (Germany/DACH): 
  * The *Terms and Conditions of Digistore24 for Buyers* state: *“The terms and conditions... shall apply to the free use of the online platform www.digistore24.com... as well as for all contracts concluded via the same between Digistore24 GmbH, St.-Godehard-Straße 32, 31139 Hildesheim... and you as our customer”*. 
  * The German privacy notice and imprint identify the responsible data controller and platform operator as: *“Digistore24 GmbH, St.-Godehard-Straße 32, 31139 Hildesheim, Germany”*.
* **Digistore24 Inc.** (United States / Global): 
  * The *Terms of Sale and Conditions of Use* define: *“Your use of https://www.digistore24.com/, including any sub-domains thereof, affiliated websites, and mobile applications... which are owned and maintained by Digistore24 Inc. (‘Digistore24,’ ‘we,’ ‘our,’ ‘us’)”*.
* **Digistore24 MSLW Limited** (Ireland / Europe):
  * The European *Terms of Sale and Conditions of Use* state: *“Your use of www.digistore24.com... which are owned and/ or licensed and maintained by Digistore24 MSLW Limited, Ormond Building, 31-36 Ormond Quay Upper, Dublin 7, D07 EE37, Ireland... are governed by the policies, terms, and conditions set forth below”*.
